prompt: Review whether dLocal has a material causal relationship to digital finance and crypto rails through emerging-market payment acceptance, payouts, settlement, local integrations and foreign-exchange infrastructure; accept or reject the edge without requiring crypto exposure.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: Broader regulated digital-payment adoption can increase payment acceptance, payout and settlement demand across emerging markets; dLocal can convert that demand through local licenses, payment methods, integrations and foreign-exchange liquidity into TPV, gross profit and cash flow without requiring cryptocurrency exposure.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject the edge if digital-finance adoption fails to drive material normalized earnings, pricing and merchant concentration absorb volume growth, or regulatory, settlement-liquidity, foreign-exchange, dilution and capital-allocation costs prevent durable per-share cash conversion.
